entries.title: The Connect card says reads ask you too
entries.body: When your first mate offers to connect GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Google, its card now says that each action, reads included, asks you on a card until you choose Always allow. Before, it said reads ran without asking. The card also shows in the language you chose for Infinitary.

picture.alt: The first mate's Connect GitLab card, saying each action, reads included, asks you on a card until you choose Always allow, with Not now and Open Integrations
